chunks.heading: Before ordering
chunks.text: Verify the caller and confirm the mailing address. If the address changed, follow KA-1002 Member Address Change before ordering the card.
chunks.embedText: Replacement Member ID Card | Before ordering | Verify the caller and confirm the mailing address. If the address changed, follow KA-1002 Member Address Change before ordering the card.

chunks.heading: Ordering the card
chunks.text: Order the replacement card in CRM. It arrives in 7 to 10 business days. A digital ID card is available immediately in the member app and can be shown at the pharmacy or doctor office.
chunks.embedText: Replacement Member ID Card | Ordering the card | Order the replacement card in CRM. It arrives in 7 to 10 business days. A digital ID card is available immediately in the member app and can be shown at the pharmacy or doctor office.

chunks.heading: Temporary proof of coverage
chunks.text: If the member needs proof of coverage today, email or mail a temporary ID letter from CRM. Providers can also verify eligibility in the provider portal.
